author: Caleb Curry
description: You send in a thousand searches per second, or there's a loop in the client code because you vibe coded it. That hammers your servers: higher cost, a worse user experience, flooded logs. Rate limiting has to happen before the request ever hits the server.
title: What happens when you skip rate limiting?

author: Caleb Curry
description:
FREE - Get my video notes: https://calcur.tech/notes
Full Playlist - https://calcur.tech/backend-engineering

Most coding videos stop at the code, and most system design videos jump straight to billion-user architectures. This is the map from point A to point B: how to take an app from nothing to running in production.
You'll learn how software is organized across hardware and locations, how components communicate, and how data is stored, so you can think like a senior engineer.
